digest.component_or_area: rebar metrics command and registry documentation
propositions: rebar-janitor Discovery phase should consult rebar metrics --since/--until --output json to cite code-health lens values (module-size distribution, oversized-module count, module-size trend vs 800 cap, churn, refactor-to-addition ratio, cap-change events) as historical trend evidence
rebar metrics command and its four lens categories (agent_process, code_health, delivery, gate_economics) are not discoverable without documentation, reducing their practical utility
rebar metrics output includes unavailable{reason,accruing_since} state for metrics without accrued signal, which agents must recognize as distinct from zero values
the reusable rebar.metrics subsystem (MetricSpec, REGISTRY, is_authoritative helpers) must be documented as a library surface for consumers beyond the CLI
docs/user-guide.md lacks a dedicated Metrics section explaining when and how to invoke rebar metrics and interpret its output lenses and confidence labels
